contracts: first-start PIN parent path must be a real directory rather than a symlink
dir_fd-capable platforms create the PIN relative to an opened parent directory descriptor
parent symlink cannot redirect PIN creation outside the project
predictable first-start PIN file path is created exclusively rather than truncating an existing entry
O_NOFOLLOW is used when available to reject a symlink in the final path component
symlink target content remains unchanged when bootstrap PIN-file creation is blocked
a persisted active profile still accepting bootstrap PIN 0000 causes secure startup to fail closed
normal first start creates a regular mode-0600 PIN file with a non-default PIN
normal first start rotates the persisted profile away from bootstrap PIN 0000
known_limits: HTTP Basic Auth remains in use
no explicit invalidatable desktop logout/lock session exists yet
platforms without dir_fd use an explicit parent symlink/type check rather than descriptor-relative creation
real browser, microphone, Android-device and iPhone-device gates remain open
